description: Fine-tuned SDXL text-to-image model by RunDiffusion optimized for photorealism. Best at: photorealistic portrait and product photography. Domains: commercial, advertising, product design. Typical uses: generating architectural renders, food photography, automotive images, interior design visualizations. Not suited for: abstract art styles, stylized illustrations.

12-billion parameter text-to-image model by Black Forest Labs for high-quality image generation. Best at: converting text prompts to images with competitive quality. Domains: creative, commercial, research. Typical uses: image synthesis, visual content creation, design mockups. Not suited for: tasks requiring non-commercial license restrictions.

Multimodal OCR model for complex document understanding using GLM encoder-decoder architecture. Best at: document parsing, formula recognition, table extraction, text recognition. Domains: finance, document processing, information extraction. Typical uses: invoice processing, structured data extraction, layout-aware OCR. Not suited for: real-time high-volume processing, handwritten text.

BLIP vision-language model with ViT base backbone for image captioning. Best at: generating both conditional and unconditional image descriptions. Domains: image understanding, content accessibility. Typical uses: auto-generating image captions, image-to-text retrieval, alt text generation. Not suited for: complex visual reasoning requiring scene graph understanding.

Specialized OCR model for Japanese text recognition in manga and printed materials. Best at: extracting vertical and horizontal Japanese text with furigana support. Domains: manga, comics, Japanese publications. Typical uses: manga text extraction, Japanese document OCR, handling font variation. Not suited for: non-Japanese text, handwritten or cursive scripts.

High-performance text detection model supporting diverse scenarios and multiple languages. Best at: detecting text in varied orientations including rotated and curved text. Domains: document analysis, multilingual scene understanding. Typical uses: license plate detection, document layout analysis, rotated text localization. Not suited for: text recognition (detection-only model), very small or blurry text.

BLIP vision-language model with ViT large backbone for advanced image captioning. Best at: generating detailed image descriptions and captions. Domains: image understanding, content accessibility, media analysis. Typical uses: generating descriptive captions, creating detailed alt text, image-to-text understanding. Not suited for: visual reasoning tasks requiring scene graph analysis.

Text-to-audio-video generation model with 4-step inference using FastH3 and VSA distillation. Best at: fast synchronized audio-video synthesis from text. Domains: video production, multimedia. Typical uses: generating short videos with synchronized audio, creative media content. Not suited for: high-resolution or long-form production video, consumer GPU deployment.

Lightweight text-to-video model optimized for consumer GPUs, requiring 8GB VRAM. Best at: text-to-video generation on limited hardware. Domains: accessible video creation. Typical uses: generating 480P videos, consumer video synthesis, accessible animation. Not suited for: high-resolution output (720P), long-duration videos, production workflows.

Uncensored video generation model based on LTX 2.3 architecture supporting text-to-video and image-to-video. Best at: flexible video generation with minimal content restrictions. Domains: creative video synthesis. Typical uses: T2V synthesis, I2V generation, creative video content. Not suited for: content requiring safety alignment, professional production standards.

Text-image-to-video model supporting 720P resolution at 24fps with Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Best at: high-definition video generation from text and images. Domains: professional video production, cinematic content. Typical uses: 720P video synthesis, image-to-video generation, cinematic video creation. Not suited for: real-time generation without sufficient VRAM, consumer deployment without optimization.

Video masked autoencoder model pre-trained on Kinetics-400 for self-supervised video representation learning. Best at: extracting generalizable video features for downstream tasks. Domains: video understanding, representation learning. Typical uses: video classification fine-tuning, feature extraction for transfer learning. Not suited for: direct zero-shot video classification, real-time applications.

Meta's V-JEPA 2 video understanding model using joint embedding predictive architecture. Best at: video representation learning for classification and retrieval tasks. Domains: video analysis, multimedia retrieval. Typical uses: video classification, video-text retrieval, extracting video embeddings. Not suited for: video generation, frame-level tasks.

X-CLIP video-language model for zero-shot video classification trained on Kinetics-400. Best at: zero-shot video classification and video-text matching without fine-tuning. Domains: video understanding, action recognition. Typical uses: zero-shot action recognition, video-text retrieval, content classification. Not suited for: video generation, frame-level analysis.

Sentence embedding model producing 384-dimensional dense vectors trained on 1 billion sentence pairs. Best at: semantic search, text clustering, and similarity detection. Domains: information retrieval, NLP. Typical uses: semantic document search, clustering similar texts, paraphrase detection. Not suited for: multilingual tasks (English-optimized), very long documents.

Multilingual sentence embedding model with 384-dimensional output supporting multiple languages. Best at: cross-lingual semantic search and multilingual text clustering. Domains: multilingual NLP, international information retrieval. Typical uses: cross-lingual document search, multilingual clustering, paraphrase detection. Not suited for: domain-specific embeddings without fine-tuning.

Multilingual embedding model supporting 100+ languages with hybrid retrieval capabilities (dense, sparse, ColBERT). Best at: dense and sparse retrieval with long context (up to 8192 tokens). Domains: multilingual information retrieval, RAG systems. Typical uses: hybrid search combining dense and sparse methods, long document retrieval. Not suited for: image or multimodal embeddings.

Text embedding model using Matryoshka Representation Learning for resizable dimensions with task-specific prefixes. Best at: flexible-dimension embeddings for search, clustering, and classification. Domains: information retrieval, semantic search. Typical uses: document search embeddings, query embeddings, text classification features. Not suited for: image embeddings, real-time tasks with unknown task types.

Multilingual sentence embedding model with 384 dimensions supporting 100 languages from XLM-RoBERTa. Best at: multilingual semantic search and similarity detection. Domains: multilingual NLP, international information retrieval. Typical uses: cross-lingual document search, multilingual clustering, query-document matching. Not suited for: domain-specific embeddings without fine-tuning, non-text data.

Cross-encoder reranker model for multilingual relevance scoring based on BGE-M3. Best at: re-ranking search results to improve relevance. Domains: information retrieval, RAG pipelines. Typical uses: filtering retrieved search results, relevance scoring in RAG systems, improving retrieval quality. Not suited for: real-time scoring at large scale without optimization, initial dense retrieval.
